howItWorks.title: From sign up to signed deal
howItWorks.subtitle: Five steps. No cold outreach, no gatekeeping — just the introduction that moves your work forward.

1.title: Sign Up
1.description: Create a free account in under two minutes. Tell us whether you are investing, building, hiring or raising.

2.title: Create Your Profile
2.description: Add your sector, stage, ticket size or expertise. The more specific you are, the sharper your matches.

3.title: Get Matched by AI
3.description: Our AI pairs you with the people whose goals, stage and geography align with yours — no spray-and-pray outreach.

4.title: Connect & Chat
4.description: Start a conversation inside a private dealroom. See who you're talking to, verify credibility, and move the conversation forward.

5.title: Close the Deal
5.description: Agree on terms, wire the funds, sign the contract. Close your first deal on AfroConnect — then come back for the next one.
